en-UK.name: Beilu Companion (Live2D · Image · Eye)
en-UK.description: Desktop companion 3-in-1: Live2D/image avatar, speech bubble, and screen perception (screenshot → AI context).
en-UK.description_markdown: **Beilu Companion** bundles three features: ① avatar rendering (Live2D models or image packs), ② the desktop speech bubble, ③ screen perception — desktop screenshots injected as one-time temporary AI context (never persisted in chat history).
en-UK.author: 凛倾

zh-CN.name: 桌宠三合一(Live2D·图片·屏幕感知)
zh-CN.description: 桌宠插件三合一:虚拟形象(Live2D/图片包) + 对话框 + 屏幕感知(截图临时注入 AI)
zh-CN.description_markdown: **桌宠三合一**(凛倾 2026-07-09 定):① 虚拟形象 — Live2D 模型或图片包(同表情多图随机,AI 表情键即切图);② 桌面对话框 — 颜色/名标/字号/尖角全可调;③ 屏幕感知 — 桌面截图作为一次性临时上下文注入 AI,不入聊天记录。
zh-CN.author: 凛倾
